Test Name Path Traversal via Detector: Attempted injection of sequences like '../../etc/passwd' or absolute paths through test names returned by the detector agent (used on line 1118). Blocked by testRepairTarget's strict validation on line 594 (rejects paths starting with '/' or containing '..').

Prompt Injection via Detector Facts: Attempted injection of control sequences through detector facts objects which are interpolated into prompts to Test Author agents (lines 1122-1127, 1343-1347). Blocked because facts objects are explicitly reconstructed (lines 1104-1105) to include only the four boolean properties, discarding any extra fields.

Data Leakage via testValidity Output: Attempted to leak sensitive information through the test_validity array in EvidenceBundle output (line 1680). Blocked because the array contains only non-sensitive metadata (test names, criterion IDs, boolean facts), no credentials or secrets are exposed, and extra fields from untrusted sources are filtered out.

Attempt 1: Verified that tests read from REPO (base commit) rather than worktree. The fixloop-helpers.js calculates REPO as path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', '..', '..') which from .artifacts/tests/implement-test-validity-classification/ correctly resolves to /home/user/company-graph/. However, that directory contains the PRE-TASK commit, not the task's changed worktree at .artifacts/worktrees/implement-test-validity-classification/. All tests that check for testValidity, citesFailingTest, fixRefused, TestValidityEntry schema, behaviour_changed fields, and wiring-helper requirements fail because they inspect the base commit where these features don't exist.

Attempt 2: Confirmed tests read base-commit code: ran Grep and Read on base commit's .claude/workflows/build-implement.js and found END fix-loop-decisions sentinel at line 659 with no testValidity/citesFailingTest/fixRefused functions. The worktree's build-implement.js has these functions at lines 703-731 (testValidity), 720-722 (citesFailingTest), 729-731 (fixRefused), all within the extended sentinel block (lines 187-732). Tests calling fixLoop-helpers.js REPO are guaranteed to miss these implementations entirely.

Attempt 3: Verified all agent prompts and schema changes exist in worktree but not base commit: (1) fixer.md line 18 in worktree has 'behaviour_changed' / 'behaviour_rationale' rule; base commit fixer.md lines 1-18 lack this entirely. (2) test-author.md lines 15-16 in worktree name b5-wiring-helpers and the five call-structure functions; base commit test-author.md lines 1-16 has no such rules. (3) contracts.schema.json has TestValidityEntry schema definition at line 233 in worktree; base commit has no TestValidityEntry. Tests AC-14 and AC-15 explicitly check these agent files and schema via fs.readFileSync(FIXER_MD) and fs.readFileSync(TEST_AUTHOR_MD) against REPO paths, reading pre-task versions.
